name: Najd Alharthi
headline: Wellcome To Najd's Page
tagline: Turning complex processes into smarter systems.
role: Industrial Engineer | Process Improvement & Production Planning
intro: I explore how data, thoughtful planning, and engineering methods can make manufacturing systems more efficient.
about:
I'm an Industrial Engineering graduate from Taif University with a GPA of 3.95/4.00 and an interest in production planning, process improvement, and manufacturing operations.

During my internship at Hitachi Energy, I gained practical exposure to material planning, production planning, industrial engineering, and quality. I used Excel to compare SAP and MES data, identify discrepancies, and support planning discussions. I also worked with Power BI.

My graduation project applied Lean Six Sigma DMADV to the design of a new GIB assembly line. This portfolio brings together my projects, technical knowledge, and ongoing learning.
journey_intro: A growing collection of lessons, engineering concepts, and reflections on practical applications.
